items.title: What we know about the cause of the nationwide FAA ground stop
items.summary: All flights nationwide were grounded for hours on Friday after a systems failure, leading to thousands of flights being delayed or canceled, disrupting the travel plans of passengers heading into the weekend.
items.titleZh: 我们对美国联邦航空局全国停飞原因的了解
items.summaryZh: 周五，由于系统故障，全国所有航班停飞数小时，导致数千架航班延误或取消，扰乱了即将进入周末的乘客的旅行计划。

items.title: The downfall of AI’s $5.7 trillion man
items.summary: The founder and CEO turned Nvidia into the linchpin of the AI boom. Can it survive without him?
items.titleZh: 人工智能价值5.7万亿美元的人的垮台
items.summaryZh: 这位创始人兼首席执行官将Nvidia变成了人工智能繁荣的关键。没有他，它能活下去吗？

items.title: Nvidia board urged to consider 'potential return of Jensen Huang' by two major investors
items.summary: Two Nvidia investors with about $2.13 billion of stock disclosed as of June 30 are calling for a deliberate leadership search after Huang’s resignation.
items.titleZh: 英伟达董事会敦促两家主要投资者考虑黄仁勋的潜在回报
items.summaryZh: 截至6月30日，两家英伟达投资者披露了约21.3亿美元的股票，他们呼吁在黄辞职后进行深思熟虑的领导层搜寻。

items.title: A petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO has over 100,000 signatures, including some big names
items.summary: Organizers of the petition say some 50,000 shareholders and 5,000 current Nvidia employees, have signed their petition to bring back Jensen Huang.
items.titleZh: 一份要求恢复黄仁勋英伟达首席执行官职位的请愿书有超过10万人签名，其中包括一些大牌
items.summaryZh: 请愿书的组织者表示，约5万名股东和5000名英伟达现任员工已签署请愿书，要求召回黄仁勋。

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Other AI Giants Face Lawsuit Demanding Development Freeze
items.summary: Four nonprofit advocacy groups want a California court to stop major AI developers from building stronger models, alleging their technology could cause catastrophic harm worldwide.
items.titleZh: OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌和其他人工智能巨头面临要求冻结开发的诉讼
items.summaryZh: 四个非营利倡导组织希望加州法院阻止主要的人工智能开发人员构建更强大的模型，声称他们的技术可能会在全球范围内造成灾难性的伤害。

items.title: Huawei set to challenge Tesla Powerwall with new, 20 kW home battery
items.summary: This high-tech Huawei home battery pack hopes to hold back Tesla’s latest Powerwall with silicon carbide technology, AI-powered energy management baked in, and enough modular storage to keep even large homes bright and warm when the rest of the block goes dar…
items.titleZh: 华为将用新的20千瓦家用电池挑战特斯拉Powerwall
items.summaryZh: 这款高科技的华为家用电池组希望通过碳化硅技术、内置的人工智能能源管理和足够的模块化存储来阻挡特斯拉最新的Powerwall，即使在街区的其他地方变暗时，也能让大房子保持明亮和温暖…

items.title: Tesla and Amazon are building the workforce a 1921 play imagined: One that never asks for a wage
items.summary: Tesla’s Optimus is in early production and Agility is public. A 1921 play shows why automation’s risk hides in the aggregate.
items.titleZh: 特斯拉和亚马逊正在打造1921年设想的劳动力：一个从不要求工资的劳动力
items.summaryZh: 特斯拉的Optimus正在早期生产，Agility已经上市。1921年的一部戏剧揭示了为什么自动化的风险隐藏在总体上。

items.title: Meet the seven co-founders of Anthropic
items.summary: Four researchers, a former journalist, a public policymaker, and an engineer founded Anthropic in 2021. They're now poised to become multi-billionaires.
items.titleZh: 认识Anthropic的七位联合创始人
items.summaryZh: 2021年，四名研究人员、一名前记者、一名公共政策制定者和一名工程师创立了Anthropic。他们现在准备成为亿万富翁。

items.title: Wealthy parents pay $75,000 for Alpha’s two-hour AI school day. Half of its K-8 students missed the math target
items.summary: Only 42% of Alpha students hit its 2x learning goal in math and reading, internal data show, as 2,600 public school students now use its software.
items.titleZh: 富裕的父母为Alpha的两小时人工智能学校日支付了75000美元。一半的K-8学生没有达到数学目标
items.summaryZh: 内部数据显示，只有42%的阿尔法学生在数学和阅读方面达到了2倍的学习目标，目前有2600名公立学校学生使用其软件。
